title: HLA-B27
what: This blood test checks for a special marker protein on your cells. It is more common in people with inflammation of the spine and joints.
why: For long-lasting lower back pain, especially in the morning and at rest, or for inflammation of the joints or eyes.
duration: the blood draw usually takes 5 minutes; results usually come in a few days
tell_doctor: How long your back has hurt, and when it is worse: in the morning or after activity
If you had inflammation of the eyes, joints, bowel, or skin

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: You usually do not need to fast. If you are having other tests at the same time, check with the lab.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Do not stop anything on your own. Medicines do not affect this test.

steps: You sit down, and a band is tied above your elbow
The skin is wiped with antiseptic
Blood is taken from a vein into a tube
The band is removed, and a cotton pad is pressed on the spot
feel: A quick prick, like a pinch
Sometimes slight dizziness. Tell the nurse, and they will help you lie down
after: Press the cotton pad for 3 to 5 minutes
Results usually come in a few days
A positive result is not a diagnosis. Many people with this marker are healthy
The doctor reads the test together with your symptoms and scans

faq.q: I have HLA-B27. Am I sick?
faq.a: Not necessarily. Many healthy people have this marker. A diagnosis is made only from symptoms, an exam, and scans.

faq.q: Do I need to repeat the test?
faq.a: No. It is something you are born with. It does not change.

reminders.text: HLA-B27 blood test tomorrow. You usually do not need to fast. Bring your referral.
